projects.name: Rubrik DR backup
notes: 2026-10-14 (rubrik transcript, Rubrik SyncUp, speakers Earle Long, Calvin Cochran, Igor Kulyk): Pure-based Oracle backup has run several days without issues, so IOSP-1011 and IOSP-1014 treated as complete. RAC (Rubrik) backup enablement had been planned for Fri 10/16 18:00 UTC.

2026-10-14 (rubrik transcript, Calvin Cochran): shipment date (preliminary 10/27) cannot be moved up until procurement signs the shipping contract; appliance shutdown prep is a few hours (give each of about a dozen nodes its new IP, then shut down). Physical work will be done by Tech X, resold via MicroAge; two Sectigo people (Olu plus Jamie) must be present in the cage. IOSP-1013 target set to 10/21.
2026-10-14 (rubrik transcript, Earle Long): DBA background work (IOSP-1009) may start earlier than November, possibly by end of week of 10/19-10/23; standby now running in Manchester and catching up.

2026-10-14 (rubrik transcript, Calvin Cochran, Prajeet Singh Kahlon, Earle Long): finding that the Secaucus RAC nodes have no interface on the CA Backup VLAN (130/2988), so Rubrik cannot reach them. Agreed to request CA backup VLAN addressing via an RM ticket; production RAC work can only be done in a maintenance window, which pushed the RAC backup start to after the weekend maintenance (Sat 7pm ET); first run later scheduled for Sunday 10/18.

2026-10-14 (rubrik transcript, Prajeet Singh Kahlon, Earle Long): debated whether to run RMAN cron backups and Rubrik 16-hour initial backup concurrently on production; decision to let them run together (worked on POC), Sunday 10/18 13:00 UTC start suggested so it ends around 05:00 UTC Monday.

2026-10-14 (rubrik transcript): one RAC database (two instances on shared storage); open question how Rubrik should address it (scan name vs per-node IP). Actions: Prajeet to open Oracle Support ticket, SriChand Myla and Calvin to ask Rubrik support.

2026-10-15 (rubrik chat, Prajeet Singh Kahlon): research result - no floating backup VIP needed on RAC; give each RAC node its own static backup IP and register both nodes with Rubrik; backup IPs do not need to be registered with Oracle Clusterware.
2026-10-15 (rubrik chat, Prajeet Singh Kahlon): requested approvals for RM-1661 (Oracle Credentials Wallet for Rubrik backup on SASP production RAC) planned for the weekend.

2026-10-16/17 (rubrik chat, Earle Long, Calvin Cochran): SASP maintenance Sat 10/17 7-9pm ET; RM-1658 (CA Backup VLAN on RAC hosts) applied by Andrey Kozudaev; Prajeet created Oracle Credentials Wallet on both RAC nodes and tested; 'Oracle part is done, pending backup VLAN and Rubrik validation'.

2026-10-18 (rubrik chat, Earle Long, SriChand Myla, Calvin Cochran): Rubrik backup on scdpcasasp1 finished; initial backup on scdpcarac1 running (progress reported 61% by SriChand and 19% by Calvin, see gaps); Earle commented out SQLNET.WALLET_OVERRIDE in sqlnet.ora (it broke local PDB connectivity); archived logs backed up hourly.

2026-10-19 (rubrik chat, Earle Long): backup create ran Sun 10/18 05:06 to Mon 10/19 03:58 (UTC); restore preview ran 03:58-04:04 successfully; cloud upload not visible in logs. Remaining for Secaucus: grant DBAs access to Rubrik and share a training guide or hold a training session.

2026-10-19 (standup transcript, Calvin Cochran): 'we have Oracle backup under Rubrik from RAC'; thanks to Earle and Prajeet. Gabriel Rovira asked about overlapping Oracle backup points; Calvin: decide after full end state (shipped and running).
2026-10-19 (standup transcript, Calvin Cochran, Karl Witt): current holdup is the shipping contract; Karl to have Karen Hodgson/Mike check contract status.

2026-10-20 (standup transcript, Calvin Cochran): daily run mode, logs picked up hourly, looks OK; still need the contract to ship; three appliances will ship to Manchester (Jaime Larsen asked, Calvin confirmed).

2026-10-20 (status email, Igor Kulyk): status ON-TRACK. Completed: IOSP-1012 (10/16 18:00 UTC, Sri), RM-1658 (CA Backup VLAN), RM-1661 (Oracle Wallet on production RAC); in progress IOSP-880 validate Rubrik RAC backup and replication (10/17-10/20). Upcoming: meeting with Network team 10/20; IOSP-1013 10/21 (Sri, Calvin); IOSP-1010 10/21-TBD shipment plan and contracts (Karl/Calvin, procurement); IOSP-1015 international shipment Oct 27-Nov 9 (logistics); IOSP-1009 DBA background work Oct 23-Nov 23 (Earle); IOSP-1004/1005 rack and validate Nov 9-16 (Manchester team, Priya/Mena); IOSP-1006 Nov 16-Dec 6 (Calvin, Sri); IOSP-1007 Nov 30-Dec 6; IOSP-1008 fully production in Europe Dec 7.

2026-10-14 (status email, Igor Kulyk): ON-TRACK; waiting response from Oracle (Prajeet), then Calvin creates RM ticket for maintenance window; shipment pending Karl and procurement; IOSP-1011 (Earle) and IOSP-1014 (Calvin) completed.

action_items.text: Shipment: provide updates on shipment preparation and sign shipping contract (IOSP-1010)

Karl Witt travelling to UK/Manchester the week of 10/19 may slow procurement follow-up (standup 10/19).
Rubrik initial backup runs ~16 hours and overlaps with production RMAN backups; first run happened over a weekend.
Rubrik backup progress readings differ (61% vs 19% on 10/18); cloud upload not verified in logs.
RAC DBA team capacity: Oracle Linux upgrade and decommissioning of old DBs queued behind RAC project.

non_project.title: Pure storage utilization
non_project.detail: 10/19: Secaucus 80%, Bradford1 77%, Bradford2 93%, Manchester 69% (Jeff Novick figures relayed by Eric Sambraus). 10/20: Secaucus 81%, Manchester 80%, Bradford 78%, Bradford 2 90% ('some deduplication in order'). 10/14 chat: Sec 78, Man 68, Brad1 78, Brad2 81.

non_project.title: Failed weekend P0 Debian 12 upgrades (rolled back)
non_project.detail: 10/19 Jeff Novick chat: Debian 12 upgrades did not go well (dot-release incompatibilities such as bind 9.18 to 9.20; AVS upgrade gave 404 errors) and were rolled back to Debian 11 when the maintenance window closed. 10/20: all four P0 upgrades show the same issue; Jeff researching but cannot debug live systems; also new issue with Bradford hosts. Firewall upgrade ticket 12020 updated. Impact on P1 work and sprint schedule.
non_project.status: Rolled back; investigation open, no owner for parallel work

non_project.title: Weekend PagerDuty escalations not acknowledged
non_project.detail: Maarten Broekman: about 10 pages escalated to management on call because primary and secondary did not acknowledge (BDDCM mail machine, BDDU Postgres machine, Pingdom timeouts). Karl Witt and Calvin Cochran: speak to on-call; kill or snooze non-actionable alerts; Calvin will ask each outgoing primary for top two noisy alerts weekly; Karl clarified manager-on-call role is escalation only (Prajeet on manager on call this week).

non_project.title: ccmqa mail flood on bdddcmmail1 / notification-sender restart loops
non_project.detail: 10/16-17 Maarten Broekman: hundreds of millions of messages to ccmqa.com local users filled /home then root filesystem on bdddcmmail1; root cause traced to notification-sender restart loops on bdddink8s; disk usage under control but triggered again; Alex cleared logs. 10/19: somebody must follow up with the SCM QA team.
non_project.status: Root cause found with one gap open; owner for QA follow-up not named

non_project.title: BDDU Postgres disk filling (logical replication broken)
non_project.detail: New partitions created on source DB were not replicated by logical replication; WAL accumulated and filled disk (bdducacsmpsql1). Prajeet Singh Kahlon copied objects over, replication healthy, WAL clearing; checked again 10/19 morning (good). Request: developers notify DBAs before changes once EDB is in production.

non_project.title: Ingress controller pods OOM killed (Pingdom timeouts AVS, OMS, trust provider)
non_project.detail: Production ingress controller pods crashed from exceeding memory allocation, causing Pingdom timeouts; Andrey K (technical escalation) raised memory limits, which resolved it. Maarten Broekman: memory change should not need technical escalation.

non_project.title: Open incident rail (INC 27238 and issuance incident)
non_project.detail: 10/19: issuance incident pending Akhil/engineering update; incident 3 pending Jeff Novick checking details from Akshane; incident 4 updated. 10/20: INC 27238 still waiting for Jeff to engage Akshane; Eric Sambraus to discuss an incident with Calvin Cochran after call; all incidents pending resolution and closure.

non_project.detail: Sectigo Network runbooks for existing monitoring: Eric Sambraus waiting on Joe; Pure storage recovery runbooks task 3514 waiting on Dino and Ray; SaaS connection pool pending Oleg; on-prem DNS to Cloudflare migration around Nov 2; crt.sh stays on rail for tracking.
